summary: Completed Module 07 Step 4 Verify by validating at-least-once queue delivery risks, database-level idempotency enforcement, and graceful degradation SLAs.
evidence: Analyzed at-least-once queue semantics: post-commit ACK network failure and visibility timeout expiration cause redeliveries.
Validated exact-once persistence: ingress-minted eventId UUID coupled with storage-engine UNIQUE constraints and P2002 deduplication eliminates race conditions.
Confirmed graceful degradation under queue/DB outages: public redirect SLA preserved with zero HTTP 500s while dropped telemetry is logged.
